title: ‘Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma’ Review: Hannah Einbinder and Gillian Anderson Embark on a Strange, Frustrating, Ultimately Fulfilling Exploration of Desire
summary: The filmmaker Jane Schoenbrun ('I Saw the TV Glow') once again delves into their personal life in this arresting, abstract allegory premiering in Cannes' Un Certain Regard sidebar.
